title: 손님 오기 전에: 미리 해 놓았어요, 해 두었어요
objective: By the end, you can make the -아/어/해 놓다 and -아/어/해 두다 forms correctly, including the spoken short forms 놨어요 and 뒀어요. You can also use them to say what you have already done to get ready.
summary: Learn how to use -어 놓다 and -어 두다 to say you did something ahead of time and the result is still there.

task.title: Use 놓다 and 두다
task.line: Read each item. Then fill in the blank, choose the right form, or put the words in order, as the instruction says.

forms.when: The last vowel of the verb stem is ㅏ or ㅗ (사다 → 사 놓다, 닫다 → 닫아 두다).
forms.means: Do something ahead of time, and the result is still there.
forms.exampleMeaning: Guests are coming, so I bought fruit and have it ready.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is anything other than ㅏ or ㅗ (만들다 → 만들어 두다, 켜다 → 켜 놓다).
forms.means: Same meaning: do it now so it is ready for later.
forms.exampleMeaning: I made side dishes over the weekend (so they're ready).

forms.when: The verb ends in 하다 (예약하다 → 예약해 놓다).
forms.means: Same meaning. Keep 해. Don't drop it.
forms.exampleMeaning: I've already booked a restaurant for Saturday evening.

forms.when: Use it when you keep something to use or remember later: 저장해 두다, 적어 두다, 기억해 두다.
forms.means: 두다 puts a little more focus on keeping something for later. 놓다 puts a little more focus on the result being there now. Most of the time, either one is fine.
forms.exampleMeaning: This number is important, so save it (for later).

forms.when: In everyday speech: 놓아요 → 놔요, 놓았어요 → 놨어요, 두어요 → 둬요, 두었어요 → 뒀어요.
forms.means: Same meaning, just shorter. People use these short forms all the time when they speak.
forms.exampleMeaning: It was hot, so I opened the window (and it's still open).

watchOut: 샀어 놓았어요 (X) → 사 놓았어요 (O): Put the tense only on 놓다 or 두다, not on the first verb.
예약 놓았어요 (X) → 예약해 놓았어요 (O): With 하다 verbs, keep 해 before 놓다 or 두다.
창문이 열어 놨어요 (X) → 창문을 열어 놨어요 (O): Someone did the action, so the thing takes 을/를. To describe only the state, say 창문이 열려 있어요.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -아/어 놓다 (past, polite): 손님이 오기 전에 바닥을 ____. (닦다)
Fill in the blank with -아/어 두다 (past, polite): 다음 달 여행 때문에 비행기 표를 미리 ____. (끊다)
Fill in the blank with -해 두다 and -(으)세요: 회의 시간이 바뀌었으니까 꼭 ____. (메모하다)
Choose the correct one: ① 회의 전에 자료를 (복사 놓았어요 / 복사해 놓았어요). ② 아침에 도시락을 (쌌어 두었어요 / 싸 두었어요). ③ 추워서 (문을 닫아 놨어요 / 문이 닫아 놨어요).
Complete B's answer with 챙기다 + 놓다 or 두다 (past, polite): A: 내일 아침 일찍 나가야 하는데 준비 다 했어요? B: 네, 가방을 벌써 ____.
Put the words in order. The air conditioner is still on: 나갔어요 / 켜 / 에어컨을 / 놓고
answers: ① 복사해 놓았어요 ② 싸 두었어요 ③ 문을 닫아 놨어요
챙겨 놓았어요 (챙겨 놨어요, 챙겨 두었어요, 챙겨 뒀어요)
